args.target: T027 responsiveness: repo page with refresh buttons at 375, 768 and 1280px (same-origin iframes)

args.condition: document.querySelector('#h-tracking') !== null
(() => { document.querySelector('.app').style.display = 'none'; document.body.style.background = 'black'; return true; })()

(() => { document.querySelectorAll('iframe').forEach(x => x.remove()); const f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.id = 'f375'; f.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:375px;height:900px;border:0;background:white'; f.src = '/repos/1001'; document.body.append(f); return true; })()

(() => { const d = document.getElementById('f375').contentDocument; return !!d && d.readyState === 'complete' && !!d.querySelector('.rescrape button') && Object.keys(d.querySelector('.rescrape button')).some(k => k.startsWith('__reactProps')); })()
(() => { const d = document.getElementById('f375').contentDocument, w = document.getElementById('f375').contentWindow; return d.documentElement.scrollWidth <= 375 && d.body.scrollWidth <= 375; })()

(() => { const d = document.getElementById('f375').contentDocument, w = document.getElementById('f375').contentWindow; return [...d.querySelectorAll('.rescrape-actions button')].length === 2 && [...d.querySelectorAll('.rescrape-actions button')].every(b => { const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.left >= 0 && r.right <= 375 && r.width > 0; }); })()

(() => { const d = document.getElementById('f375').contentDocument, w = document.getElementById('f375').contentWindow; return [...d.querySelectorAll('.group-list li')].every(l => l.getBoundingClientRect().right <= 375) && d.querySelector('.group-list').getBoundingClientRect().right <= 375; })()

(() => { const d = document.getElementById('f375').contentDocument, w = document.getElementById('f375').contentWindow; return [...d.querySelectorAll('.rescrape-actions button')].every(b => b.getBoundingClientRect().height >= 44); })()
(() => { const d = document.getElementById('f375').contentDocument, w = document.getElementById('f375').contentWindow; return (d.querySelectorAll('.rescrape-actions button')[1].click(), true); })()

(() => { const d = document.getElementById('f375').contentDocument, w = document.getElementById('f375').contentWindow; return d.querySelectorAll('.rescrape__status')[1].textContent.startsWith('Refresh queued for'); })()

(() => { const d = document.getElementById('f375').contentDocument, w = document.getElementById('f375').contentWindow; return d.documentElement.scrollWidth <= 375 && d.body.scrollWidth <= 375 && d.querySelectorAll('.rescrape__status')[1].getBoundingClientRect().right <= 375; })()
(() => { const d = document.getElementById('f375').contentDocument, w = document.getElementById('f375').contentWindow; return !d.querySelectorAll('.rescrape-actions button')[1].disabled; })()
